sourceEntry.ref: This study: BCA BEBR 2023 EUI of the training half of the matched commercial buildings (qa/sg_bca_validation.md, tools/sg/calibrate_bca.mjs)

meta.method: Office, retail, hotel: type multipliers on P_equip and E_other, posterior by random-walk MCMC on a linear surrogate of the model EUI (checked against full model runs), Student-t (ν 4) likelihood of ln(measured / model), priors ln m ~ N(0, s) with s from the table P10–P90; value = table value × posterior median multiplier, P10–P90 = posterior P10–P90. useScale (new key, a factor on the occupant, lighting, equipment and other loads together): value 1 (mixed: fitted), P10–P90 = the between-building spread, two-piece log-normal widths set on the training half so that 10 % of its buildings fall below and 10 % above the model P10–P90 (surrogate with P_equip and E_other drawn from their posterior ranges). Together the ranges are the posterior plus the residual spread.
meta.mixed: P_equip and E_other not fitted: mixed developments take the calibrated office, retail and hotel values through their BCA GFA shares (archetype_sg.js assign), their own P_equip and E_other the blend-weighted mean of those multipliers; their useScale (value and range) is fitted on the mixed training buildings
meta.tierNote: calibrated: fitted to measured EUI of Singapore buildings (BCA). Not for residential types.

domain.rule: calibrated values apply to BCA-listed buildings and to unlisted outlines with GFA (refAreaFactor × footprint × storeys) ≥ gfaMin of their type; smaller unlisted outlines keep the table values
domain.basis: smallest BCA GFA among the training buildings of the type, rounded down to 100 m² (training half, qa/sg_bca_validation.json, seed 20261126); tools/sg/calib_domain.mjs
